title: Show network settings for a specific device
summary: Display detailed network configuration information for a specific network service, such as Wi-Fi or Ethernet.

steps.explain: Get information for a specific network service. Replace <SERVICE_NAME> with the name from the list of services (e.g., "Wi-Fi").

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the network service, e.g., Wi-Fi or Ethernet.

steps.expect: Network configuration details like IP address, subnet mask, and router.
